text: Yes, the 2023 tree-cover loss on this property is confirmed. Satellite data (Hansen GFC) detected a loss of about 4.5 hectares (0.12% of the asset) in 2023, primarily in planted forests (*Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*). The loss was corroborated by later observations (up to 2025) and aligned with the 2020 forest reference map (JRC GFC2020), meeting the methodology’s standards for validation. However, the evidence does not specify the cause (e.g., harvesting, natural disturbance) or legality of the loss.
